name: Robin Hood - Bot Manager
tagline: Weekly audit of your bot roster: live, idle or redundant
description: Once a week it reviews every assistant you have installed and sorts them into still earning their keep, sitting idle, or duplicating another bot's job. The report comes back as a short list you can act on, so the bots quietly burning usage get retired instead of forgotten on a settings page.
author: Cultureofsports
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
